architecture.rationale: Plain 3D U-Net with sixteen initial channels, pooling and concatenated skips; no residual units, attention or deep supervision. Same BasicUNet topology as the width32 pilot, reduced channel capacity.

learning_rate_policy: AdamW 3e-4, 5% linear warmup (55 updates), cosine decay to 1% initial LR (3e-6) over 1095 updates.
